# Release June 11

26.28.0

### Document Library

The Document Library is a new collection of ready-to-use document processing templates, so you can start from a proven setup instead of building one from scratch.

Each template contains a common use case, such as fraud checks for financial documents, invoice processing, document classifiers, MRZ checks for identity documents, and more. Pick a template and the platform automatically creates the necessary configurations.

### Business rules

Business Rules is a new component that lets you define your own logic on how your data should be handled during processing. Define conditions on captured fields or the outputs of other components (such as Fraud or Quality).

When a condition is met, the rule can, for example, flag an invoice for review if the amount exceeds a certain amount, or the rule can automatically reject a document if a required field is missing.

Business Rules run in the order you set and can be enabled or disabled individually, so your own logic is built into the capturing process directly. Business Rules work alongside other components, so you can also base conditions on results from checks like Fraud Detection or Quality Analysis.

### Financial

Large documents are now processed faster thanks to improvements in how pages are handled in parallel, reducing overall parsing time.

The financial extraction models have been retrained on the latest data (May 2026), improving accuracy across invoices and receipts.

Additional improvements include:

- The **unit of measurement** field in line items now returns position coordinates, consistent with other line-item fields.

- **Currency detection** is now more precise. Low-confidence currency values are only accepted when they match the country of the document, reducing incorrect currency results.


### Other improvements & fixes

- **Custom Fields - Coordinate Display:** Field coordinates are now only shown for custom fields when coordinate display is explicitly enabled for a configuration, keeping the interface cleaner and focused on what is relevant.

- **Dataset Matching - Case Insensitive Search:** When matching documents against datasets, the platform now matches values regardless of capitalization. For example, "Amsterdam" and "AMSTERDAM" will both return a match, reducing the chance of missed results due to inconsistent formatting in your data.

- **E-Invoicing:** Finvoice e-invoice documents are now supported in human-in-the-loop (review) workflows.
